::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/excess_payments"}
#docs
`held_minor` is what it put there less what its refunds drew out. Invoices draw the balance oldest payment first, so `remaining_minor` is what is still on the balance from this payment; the `remaining_minor` values sum to the customer's excess balance in that currency, and a payment with nothing left is not listed. `refundable_minor` is what a refund of this payment can take now, never more than `remaining_minor`. Refund one with `POST …/payments/{pay}/refund`. Integer minor units. `include_used=true` also lists the payments whose excess invoices used up (`remaining_minor` 0).
